kurz: How much water is on a surface decides between steaming and browning.
bild_im_kopf: A slider between steamer and grill: the drier the surface, the further towards grill.
was_passiert: Wet surfaces get stuck at 100 °C: they cook but do not brown. Dry surfaces get hotter, brown and turn crisp. Completely dried out, they turn leathery or burn.
faustregeln: Drying before frying is almost always right.
Steam is welcome when things are meant to be juicy or soft.
